name: wbcom/wb-ad-manager
description: WordPress Ad Management Plugin with BuddyPress Integration

install-hooks: @php -r "echo 'Git hooks activated. pre-push will run composer verify-no-test (or verify when test scaffold is set up).' . PHP_EOL;"

scripts-descriptions.test: Run full PHPUnit suite (free + pro when WBAM_RUN_PRO_TESTS=1).
scripts-descriptions.lint: WPCS via PHPCS — WordPress-Extra + Docs + PHPCompat, uniform across free and pro.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 7 across both plugins.
scripts-descriptions.plugincheck: Run WP Plugin Check CLI on both plugins — no category exclusions.
scripts-descriptions.verify-flow: WP-CLI data-flow assertions against the live Local site.
scripts-descriptions.arch-checks: Free/Pro architecture-contract enforcement (delegates to PRO's bin/architecture-checks.sh).
scripts-descriptions.install-hooks: Activate the tracked git pre-push hook (bin/git-hooks/pre-push). One-time per clone.
scripts-descriptions.verify: Full local-CI gate: lint + phpstan + arch-checks + phpunit + plugincheck + verify-flow. Use before pushing.
scripts-descriptions.verify-no-test: Same as verify but skips PHPUnit. Use when WP test scaffold (install-wp-tests.sh) is not set up locally.
scripts-descriptions.dist: Build free-only and free+pro combo distribution zips.
scripts-descriptions.journeys: Write the agent-runbook for every customer-journey markdown under audit/journeys/. Hand the runbook to an LLM session with Playwright + mysql_query MCPs loaded for full execution.
scripts-descriptions.journeys:critical: Smoke-check critical journeys' environment readiness (HTTP, REST namespace, dev-auto-login mu-plugin, frontmatter, declared DB tables). Pure shell, deterministic, CI-friendly. Default for pre-push gates.
scripts-descriptions.journeys:critical-runbook: Write the agent-runbook for critical-priority journeys only. Use for full Playwright execution in an interactive QA session.
scripts-descriptions.journeys:smoke: Smoke-check ALL journeys (any priority). Useful after a fresh-install or major DB migration.
scripts-descriptions.journeys:dry-run: List journeys that would run; no execution.
